title: UG-032 — How to design a WCAG-compliant survey
intent: Provide practical accessibility design recommendations for EUSurvey questionnaires.
short_answer: Keep the questionnaire as simple as possible, prefer simple question types, avoid complex or highly visual elements, and provide meaningful descriptive text for images.
important_conditions: The main rule is to keep the survey simple.
Descriptive text for images is important for accessibility.
